output.reason: The note [ev-4ff4285f6d72] and PR #21433 [ev-f90aa5b7c8ee] state the subject and change clearly: an optional way to use Azure workload identity when configuring Microsoft Entra SSO, so the AAD app secret no longer has to be managed. Neither says how the feature is turned on or detected, such as which OIDC config key or setting enables it. That is what the open applicability aspect needs. The changed-file list [ev-435088130c8b] shows the change touched util/settings/settings.go, util/oidc/oidc.go and docs/operator-manual/user-management/microsoft.md, but their contents are not shown, so neither the setting name nor the precondition (Entra SSO through Argo CD's OIDC config) can be written as a condition. The microsoft.md doc diff or the settings.go change is needed to state which environments are exposed.
